newsitem.title: UK: UK shares end higher, further gains seen limited.
newsitem.headline: UK shares end higher, further gains seen limited.

text.p: UK shares finished up on Wednesday, helped by three-straight Wall Street advances.
But the FTSE's near-term upside potential is seen limited as investors fear interest rates will need to be increased in order to curb a booming UK economy.
"Our market's strength is all about Wall Street. The Dow has been strong the past few days and we've been riding its coatails," the head of sales and trading at a major investment bank said.
"But after the(British)election rates are going up which will not be good news for the market."
The FTSE 100 closed 23.0 points up to 4,292.3.
